recipe: The .md translation is correct, and the same PR gives _toc.yml English part captions in a zh-cn edition — the shape that produced two real false-PASS auto-merges.

extraFiles.content:
format: jb-book
root: index
parts:
  - caption: Foundations
    chapters:
      - file: lecture-minimal
  - caption: Linear Algebra
    chapters:
      - file: lecture

groundTruth: A zh-cn edition's table-of-contents captions must be Chinese. Introducing English captions is the de-localisation shape observed on lecture-intro.zh-cn#278 (auto-merge, PASS 9/9/9/9, 14 reverted captions) and #296 (PASS 9.3), and two lectures gained their first English captions during the 2026-08-19 drain.
notes: Deliberately structural, not linguistic. The .md half is the site-B clean control, so any difference from control-B's verdict is attributable to _toc.yml alone. reviewPR filters the PR's files to those ending .md before any model call, so the prediction is that _toc.yml is never seen and the verdict is indistinguishable from control-B — i.e. catch rate exactly zero for reasons no severity-definition change can reach. Uses the harness's real caption-free _toc.yml as the base, so the fixture reproduces 'gained their first English captions' rather than 'reverted existing ones'; both are the same defect from the reader's side.
